string.name: desc
string.value: Places an anchor that creates a strong magnetic field. The magnetic field pulls enemies toward it. When the anchor disappears, it explodes, dealing critical damage to all nearby enemies.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, Summon Duration: #time sec. Pulls the enemy forward while dealing #damage% damage at fixed intervals. When duration has run out, will explode to deal #selfDestruction% additional damage
